abstract: Domain.com is simple to start and costly to keep. Renewal is about three times the first-year price.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is simple to start. Renewal is about three times the first-year price, and we found no speed test.

mainEntity.name: How much does Domain.com hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starter is $35.88 for the first year and $105.99 a year at renewal.

mainEntity.name: Does Domain.com have a free trial or guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: The hosting page lists a 99% uptime guarantee. We did not find a money-back guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: HostAdvice noted that Domain.com support appears under the Network Solutions brand.

mainEntity.name: Does Domain.com have an AI website builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: HostAdvice lists one on all plans. Our read of the hosting page did not. Check the live page.
